reason: Go blocks __proto__/constructor/prototype segments by checking the blocklist against the segment with any trailing [*] wildcard stripped first, so "__proto__[*]" is blocked exactly like "__proto__". The Rust validator checked the blocklist against the raw, unstripped segment, so "__proto__[*]" slipped through while bare "__proto__" was still blocked; since fixed (endpoint/src/detection.rs json_path()) to check the stripped segment, matching Go and the extension's own valuesAt().
